generator.howTitle: How to create questions with AI
generator.howLead: The flow keeps the teacher as the reviewer and final decision maker.

0.title: Choose the source material
0.body: Use a PDF, material you prepared, or context from the available curriculum catalog.

1.title: Set the question composition
1.body: Decide the number and types of questions for a practice, quiz, or exam goal.

2.title: Create a draft with AI
2.body: Lembar processes the context and prepares question items as a draft, not an automatic final result.

3.title: Review before use
3.body: Check the questions, options, keys, and material alignment. Edit or remove items that are not right yet.

generator.reviewTitle: Teacher review is not an optional step
generator.reviewBody: AI can produce inaccurate facts, options, or difficulty levels. Check every item against the source and your students' needs.

checklist.0: Check alignment with the material and learning objectives.
checklist.1: Make sure multiple-choice questions have exactly one correct key.
checklist.2: Adapt the language, context, and difficulty to your students.
checklist.3: Edit or remove doubtful output before finalizing.

generator.outputTitle: From draft to document or online assessment
generator.outputBody: After review and finalization, use the output flow available in your workspace to prepare a teacher document, a student document, or share the assessment online.
generator.faqTitle: Questions about the AI question generator

0.question: What is the Lembar AI question generator?
0.answer: Lembar is a web app that helps teachers create question drafts from materials, PDFs, or curriculum context. Teachers still review every item before finalizing.

1.question: Can Lembar create questions from a PDF?
1.answer: Yes. Teachers can use a PDF as the source material, then decide the question composition they want. The result still needs to be checked against the source document.

2.question: What question types can be created?
2.answer: Lembar supports flows for multiple-choice, true or false, short answer, and essay questions. Final availability follows the features enabled in your workspace and the active catalog.

3.question: Are AI-generated questions ready to use immediately?
3.answer: Not always. AI content can be wrong or poorly matched to the context. That is why Lembar places a teacher review step before questions are printed or shared.

4.question: What output can be prepared after review?
4.answer: After finalization, teachers can use the teacher and student document export flow or share the assessment through the online features available in the workspace.

5.question: Can Lembar be used for Kurikulum Merdeka?
5.answer: Teachers can choose context from the currently active curriculum catalog and adapt the result to the learning objectives, material, grade level, and class needs.

generator.finalBody: Start from the material you already have, then review every result before using it in class.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions

0.question: What is lembar?
0.answer: lembar helps teachers compose assessment drafts, review every item, then prepare the result for printing or sharing.

1.question: How much does it cost?
1.answer: Pricing, quotas, and features follow the active catalog on the Pricing page. If the catalog is unavailable, lembar does not display fallback values.

2.question: How does the generation process work?
2.answer: The teacher chooses the context and question composition, then the system prepares a draft for review. The teacher still has to check and accept every item before finalizing.

3.question: How is question access controlled?
3.answer: The workspace requires an account session. Student links use limited tokens that can expire or be revoked and never show the answer key.

4.question: Which curricula are available?
4.answer: The available grade levels, subjects, materials, and curriculum versions follow the catalog currently active for your workspace.

5.question: How do I start using it?
5.answer: Sign in or register, choose a workspace, set the question composition, then review the draft before printing or sharing it.

faq.unansweredBody: Send your question through the contact page.

contact.routesBody: We use this form to understand your school's context, not to create automatic accounts. Do not include student data or internal documents.

security.title: Data access is kept limited and reviewable.
security.description: This page describes the controls the application currently applies, without claiming certifications that have not been published.
security.sessionBody: Session tokens are stored as HttpOnly cookies, use SameSite, and are flagged Secure in the production environment. The browser never receives provider secrets or backend credentials.

0.title: Workspace separation
0.body: The teacher, school admin, and ops areas each have server guards. Final authorisation is still verified by the backend service for every data operation.

1.title: Limited student links
1.body: Assignment links can expire or be revoked. The student endpoint does not use the legacy viewer that exposed answers and explanations.

2.title: Compliance status
2.body: Hosting, retention, storage encryption, certifications, and data processing agreements must be confirmed through official documentation or contacts before being used as a basis for organisational decisions.

meta.ogDescription: Learn how lembar protects your personal data in line with Indonesia's PDP Law.

0.title: 1. Data we collect
0.before: When you register: name, email, school name, and role (teacher/admin). When you use the platform: question creation activity logs, export metadata, and settings preferences. We do

1.title: 2. How we use it
1.before: Your information is used to provide the lembar service, personalise the experience (for example subject recommendations), and send account-related notifications. We

2.title: 3. Data protection
2.body: All data is encrypted with AES-256 at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit. Our infrastructure is ISO 27001 certified and complies with Indonesia's Personal Data Protection Law (UU PDP).

3.title: 4. Data sharing
3.body: Data is only shared if: (a) required by applicable law, or (b) with your explicit consent. We use sub-processors (hosting, email) bound by equivalent confidentiality agreements.

4.title: 5. Your rights
4.before: You have the right to access, update, export, or delete your personal data at any time through account settings. For a full deletion request, contact

5.title: 6. Policy changes
5.body: If there is a material change, we will send an email notification at least 30 days before the change takes effect. Continued use after the effective date means you accept the latest version.
